Name: Frog bucket hat
Author: romcomdemidoodle
Description:
This is an edit of this mod: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23953 where all I've done is replace their hat with a frog hat I drew. You can change up the hats as well! In the assets folder there is a picture of all the hats in the game. All you need to do is draw over one set of hat sprites and then replace the code in the content.json file as follows:

"FromFile": "assets/Mushroom_BucketHat_Frog.png"    into    "FromFile": "assets/your_new_image_name.png"
 
you don't need any coding software to do this, you can just open the .json file in notepad (remember to click save).

Ok have fun with hats!

Manifest.Name: Mushroom Bucket Hat
Manifest.Description: Changes Stardew Valleys default bucket hat to a better version.
